reason: I can't see who is in which chair or check the drawer cash when I'm away, and staff mix-ups cost me more than ₹500 a month. Only ₹5,000 is at risk, and I get it back if my stylists don't use it, so I'll try it, but only after I see it working in another salon first.
objection: It is one person supporting it. If he is sick or busy at another salon on a Sunday or during Durga Puja and billing stops with a full salon, my staff will go back to the register and I lose a day.
would_change_my_mind: If I call the support number on a busy Sunday before signing and nobody answers quickly, I will not buy.
